rationale: This condition establishes whether the required input records are obtainable so the specified crossdating procedure can start. Inventorying coverage and grouping derivative records by provenance checks ordinary instantiation requirements; it does not establish that any resulting alignment warrants a chronological inference.

if_execution.verification_or_satisfaction_method: Inventory obtainable records, trace provenance to count copies, summaries and document-refreshed recollections as one series, and confirm that at least two independent series cover an overlapping interval. Seek further records if this requirement is unmet.
